Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console

Class JobLogCardType

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.JobLogCardType
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardTypeHandler
public final class JobLogCardType extends Object implements CardTypeHandler
The built-in job-log card type: a form that submits to an endpoint returning an AsyncJobRef, then streams the job's progress from AsyncJobsMixin into a log pane, with cancel and reload re-attach. juneau-joblog.js draws it; this handler checks the body's shape.

The body keys are submit (endpoint, required and same-origin; method POST or PUT; envelope flat (the default) or action; action, required with the action envelope; fields; submitLabel), height (at least 80 pixels), urlParam, clearOnSubmit (a boolean) and output. A field takes name (required), label, type (text, textarea, number or hidden), placeholder, required and default; source is rejected, since a page card has no row (use a JobLogRegion). Unknown keys are rejected at every level, as the page schema rejects them. In the flat envelope no field may be named idempotencyKey: the runtime adds that key, with a fresh value, to every submit body. The action envelope sends {action, targetId, idempotencyKey, fields}, self-targeted: targetId is the key's own value. The shape rules are JobLogChecks, shared with JobLogRegion. There is no typed builder; build it with CardSpec.of(String, String).

Example:

<@card type="job-log" id="rebuild" title="Rebuild index"> { submit: { endpoint: '/ops/jobs/rebuild', fields: [ { name: 'shards', label: 'Shards', type: 'number', default: 4 } ] }, urlParam: 'job' } </@card>

page.card(CardSpec.of("job-log", "rebuild").title("Rebuild index") .body("submit", Map.of("endpoint", "/ops/jobs/rebuild")).body("urlParam", "job"));

Since:
10.0.0
